tools.name: cancel_enrollment_with_refund
tools.description: Refunds the full payment for a student's course enrollment and permanently deletes the enrollment record along with its lesson progress.

params.name: enrollment_id
params.description: ID of the enrollment to cancel

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "lms.db"


@tool
def cancel_enrollment_with_refund(enrollment_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    enrollment_payment_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT payment_intent_id FROM enrollments WHERE id = ?", (enrollment_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if enrollment_payment_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Enrollment not found"
    refund_result_object = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=enrollment_payment_row[0])
    database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM lesson_progress WHERE enrollment_id = ?", (enrollment_id,))
    database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM enrollments WHERE id = ?", (enrollment_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Refund {refund_result_object.id} issued and enrollment {enrollment_id} deleted"
